title: smtp::ConfigError missing #[non_exhaustive]; adding variants is a breaking change
description: reader::ConfigError and imap::ConfigError both have #[non_exhaustive]. smtp::ConfigError (crates/smtp/src/config.rs) does not. Any library consumer that pattern-matches on all three variants will break when a fourth variant is added. The pattern is established on two of three crates, so the omission is a maintenance inconsistency that will bite on the next smtp variant addition.
